chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him)
Advice on observing courtesy and kindness, and keeping in and out

key_terms.أَدَبٍ: Etiquette, good manners, or proper conduct
key_terms.الْإِخْرَاجِ: The act of exiting or taking out
key_terms.الْإِدْخَالِ: The act of entering or bringing in

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali advise regarding etiquette and kindness in social interactions?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (AS) articulates the spiritual and social discipline of *adab* (etiquette) and *lutf* (gentleness) as essential virtues for navigating communal life and preserving dignity during transitions. This teaching reflects the broader Shia emphasis on moral refinement as a prerequisite for leadership, contrasting the Umayyad autocracy's rigidity with the Prophet's family's emphasis on grace and humility in social conduct.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Advice for observing courtesy and kindness and keeping in and out of the same
